svg.text: Cleans up a messy folder using an LLM. It started as a fix for my own
downloads folder. One Go binary, nothing to install alongside it. It walks the
directory, hashes every file with SHA-256, asks an OpenAI compatible or local
Ollama endpoint where things should go, and shows you the moves in a Bubble
Tea diff. Nothing is touched until you say yes, there is a dry run if you
would rather just look, and every session goes into a JSON history file so any
